title: The EU says it "welcomes Apple's changes"; Apple will reduce its fees in the EU, charging 26% for apps with IAP, 20% for alt payments, and 15% for link-outs (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The EU says it “welcomes Apple's changes”; Apple will reduce its fees in the EU, charging 26% for apps with IAP, 20% for alt payments, and 15% for link-outs — Apple Inc. has agreed to a set of sweeping changes for its App Store in Europe, including dropping per-install fees …
